changelog: New voice command: say 'cut last character' (or 'শেষ অক্ষর কেটে নাও') alone while dictating and the last letter is cut to the clipboard and removed in one step — handy for moving a mistyped digit or letter to another app without retyping. This completes the cut family: sentence, word, paragraph, line and now character (70 commands in Help & Support > Voice commands). Also includes the v17.1 Live Translate fix. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message.
